_what: B1 §6.1 guarantee cohort at n = 30 (W4; run once guarantee9 is stable). guarantee9's groups scaled up, plus 3 idle members MOVED by the idle fan-out, 1 draft at boot (HOLD-DRAFT, a hard hold that must page by its max age) and 1 background job at boot (HOLD-BGWORK). Counts sum to 30. With idle_fanout on, go_barrier members boot WORKING, never idle (C15). KMAX 16 clamps the heavy lead to 15 and leaves 33 seats for the rest. Run with LR_RIG_HOLD_WINDOW=1 (the harness sets it) so the arm stays up until each hold has paged (C5). W4b: idle_fanout_switch sets LR_IDLE_FANOUT=on AND creates the arm's recon/idle-fanout.on (D2a), so the same matrix drives a tree before and after W13 moves the daemon to the file; and a 4-row idle move batch (extra rows on next3 → next4, not members, kitty calls slowed to hold their slots for minutes) is queued at go through the real cc-lr move and started by the poller stand-in, so the lane holds 4 of the shared swap slots while the limited members recover (W11's slot priority).
